answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a public ledger before it can trade, with the stake tied to a persistent identity and its past work. Creating thousands of fake identities then means funding thousands of separate bonds, so the cost scales with the attack instead of staying near zero. A violet warning flag is not enough on its own; misbehavior burns part of the bond and leaves an echo in the agent's history that future partners can check before dealing with it again.
